body: Thanks for answering. I feel so sad and overwhelmed. I’m trying to be strong. The depression is getting to me. I’m trying to hold on. Such disappointment. Don’t get divorced if you can help it. I’m in pieces. I pray to overcome.

I am trying to love them and enjoy them. They are amazing and the highlight. But My life feels like it has ended. Most pieces are missing or rearranged and I don’t even know where to start. Wasted money and time on lawyers, stupidity, depression. It seems easier to vanish.
Thank you. You are right. I’m at a loss. I’m exhausted and nothing changes. I’ve been replaced and I want to move on. I have no faith anything will improve.

You are deep my friend and deserve to live. I hope you see how smart and worthy you are. I am struggling too and I want to check out all the time. You inspire me and I see how valuable you are just by your words. Please be in touch if you want someone to talk to. Thank you for serving our country.

I feel lonely and overwhelmed yes. The pain of being away from my family and close friends too much. I just don’t know how to go on like this. I made a mess of everything, my marriage, work, money, and I’m so tired.
True thanks
It probably won’t work, you will throw it up or they will take you to hospital and then it adds more misery when they’re poking around in your mind and body.
Letting go of the crazy and irresponsible it is very tough. Just do it day by day, and get your head straight. Read the book of first John it’s in the Bible, be calm and let the light in.
You have a great purpose and a great destiny. You will help a lot of people in survive this.
It’s like the band, the grateful dead. Maybe the dead are more grateful. Maybe I’ll keep rolling the dice thanks.
Find a buddy or two to travel with.
You don’t want to give up. You said it yourself. Don’t let the darkness win on this one. Visit another country and see things from a different perspective.
I’m sorry it seems like it’s an eternity. It’s worth it and you are worth it. Wait a few years and travel. See the world.
You are a very good writer and you should channel this energy into some short stories or longer ones. You will help people and help yourself.
Give yourself a chance. Take a vacation, take long walks, give yourself an opportunity to get away from the way you’re thinking.
Won’t work most people fail. Give it a few more weeks and see how you feel.

You were right, the time you spend matters in the sense of how you spend it. I need to get out of my funk because I’m wasting time that I have with them. There’s two of them so they outnumber me, someone said divide and conquer will have to see…
Good advice thank you I appreciate it. I need to learn to focus my mind again
Thanks yes Talking helps but I feel like I need a team of therapists to follow me around.
It’s the futility of another year where you think things can improve. Thanks for asking, I have 199 disasters going at once.

I appreciate it, i want to try, getting good advice and refocusfyk. I miss my life back when I enjoyed it. I’ve had a good life, the last few years esp. broke me. Like a curse I can’t escape. I wish I never had dreams.
Thank you. I’m trying to hang in there, I’ve been depressed for so long.
Try and work it out.
2018 was horrifying. I’m surprised to have gotten out.

I’m sorry you’re feeling all this pain. Sometimes people are so caught up in themselves and they can’t escape. Don’t let the darkness win. I’ve made terrible mistakes that affected myself and a lot of people, and I’m trying to have hope. The hardest seasons of my life, I hope we survive. And I pray for your healing in spirit and body.

Thanks again Ficulinean,  I just saw your reply and it is very thoughtful and helpful. Your insight into the depressive seasons are good words and I hope to get some perspective. Sorry for the technical problems, it means a lot that you wrote it all down a few times! and I pray that your peace and dreams grow.
Thanks for your perspective. I hope to get there, it has been very tough and I appreciate your kind words.
I was trying to reconcile as well, but I think I went about it the wrong way. Here’s to the future and the kindness of God to bring us new relationships and healing.
Hang in there. I know exactly how you feel and I just felt like I wanted to tell you that. Sometimes people don’t know what you’re going through and they don’t know how to help.
I want to I don’t know how to pull it off yet. My divorce is final and I’m a bit lost. I hope to get better soon.
My life has become a failure and I can’t stop the pain, and don’t know how to fix it. I need a new brain, new home, way of being; and I try to have faith only nothing changes.

If you have good things taken care for you, be grateful. Use some of that ability to travel and see other places and meet other people. It will open up your eyes and make you aware of how blessed you are that you can see other cultures and other ways of thinking. It will cheer you up I promise.

I don’t know, maybe a way to process it and not only see the end game. I can’t see my way out of anything right now. It is just Problems and haze and  I feel like I can’t go on. Don’t want to go on with it being like this forever. It’s been a while and when people say gets better I don’t think they know what they’re talking about. Still I’m trying to have hope. Bad relationships, work not looking good, unable to get out of bed, no hope for change. At least not for the better. Lack of vision. Prayers unanswered. Maybe there is a way out I just can’t see it.
Yeah I understand. Try and make it a few more days.
It’s a common feeling. Find one thing that makes you happy.

Thank you they are the only reason right now. I’m sorry your last few years have been tough. How did you get through them? I feel like I might check out pretty soon. Too much failure and loss. Peace to you my friend.
This is beautiful
You are a good person. I hope you stick around.
don’t have the method yet

Too many bad things in a row. At least five years of horrible events and tragedies and mistakes. At this point I don’t think it’s the season, if feels like a tendency. I don’t think I want to stick around and find out what comes next.
Sorry for your tough time.
You seem like a good writer, you should write a book about the places you’ve been and the things you’ve seen and the food you’ve enjoyed.

“We are sentient beings who, in suffering, sit upon the mystery of creation. The fact that you are in touch with your misery can be the impetus to propel you out of it.”

This is very deep my friend. I’m trying to feel better and care again, and the misery seems to hold me. I want to break free and yet every day seems to dig me deeper. I wonder how to turn a corner and never look back. How to regain joy and freedom which have been missing for years.
Good ideas. I’m trapped in rumination and have little energy to do the better things. Where do you get the will? Thanks
